transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom lowers allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads the blacklist mapping for sender, recipient and tx.origin.
_transfer reads _isExludedFromTx to skip the maxTxAmount check.
_transfer enforces and clamps contract balance by _maxTxAmount.
_maxTxAmount is derived from _tTotal.
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to avoid circular liquidity events.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_transfer compares balance against _numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer checks presaleAddresses mapping for sender and recipient.
_transfer verifies sender is not the uniswap pair.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide the takeFee flag.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify before crediting the recipient, performing external calls mid-transfer.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) before the state-changing swap.
_transfer finally calls _tokenTransfer to move balances.
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwapAndLiquify around the swap.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for half plus marketing share.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the remaining tokens.
swapAndLiquify sends remaining ETH to the marketing wallet.
swapAndLiquify computes the marketing share using the fixed wallet.
swapTokensForEth reads the immutable router address.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth makes an external swap call that can re-enter the token contract.
addLiquidity reads the immutable router address.
addLiquidity approves the router through _approve.
addLiquidity forwards ETH to the router with zero slippage limits.
addLiquidity sends LP tokens to the owner.
sendETHToMarketing reads the marketing wallet address.
sendETHToMarketing performs an ETH transfer to a fixed payable address.
manualSwap swaps the whole contract balance through swapTokensForEth.
manualSend forwards the contract ETH balance to marketing.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded mapping.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for standard accounts.

_transferStandard increases _tFeeTotal through _reflectFee.

excludePresaleAddresses calls setExcludeFromFee on both addresses.

owner removes an address from the blacklist mapping.

deliver increases _tFeeTotal.

balanceOf converts _rOwned into tokens for non-excluded accounts.
_getValues reads the current _taxFee.
_getValues obtains the current reflection rate.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only meaningful within _transfer's blacklist and balance logic.
recipient is consumed by the same _transfer validation and accounting path.
amount feeds the _maxTxAmount check and downstream _tokenTransfer math.
maxTxPercent drives the arithmetic that writes _maxTxAmount.
taxFee is the only argument written into the _taxFee state variable.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary holder for balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
takeFee is a transient flag deciding fee application within _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is split into marketing and liquidity shares inside swapAndLiquify.
initialBalance only captures pre-swap ETH to isolate swap proceeds.
tokenAmount is approved and transferred to the owner inside recoverTokens.
presale address is whitelisted and fee-excluded solely inside excludePresaleAddresses.
